{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Oversized wool blazer, wide-leg relaxed fit, charcoal grey (#3B4C51), virgin wool.
Silk chiffon blouse, classic collar, soft ivory (#FFFFF0), silk.
Tailored wool trousers, tapered leg, midnight blue (#000038), heavy tweed.
Loafers, pointed toe, polished brown leather with a subtle sheen.
Minimalist gold stud earrings and a slender silver chain necklace to anchor the professional look without overpowering the outfit's structured silhouette. This ensemble works perfectly for an office setting in autumn because it balances warmth from the wool layers with the breathability of silk against likely cooler temperatures. The dark and neutral color palette exudes authority and sophistication while remaining comfortable for a full day of work. The combination of tailored pieces adheres to your request for a "smart" level of formality, ensuring you look polished yet approachable in a business environment."}
